central_sentences.text: Understanding is not the elimination of remainder. It is the growing ability to move truthfully with a remainder that is named, situated, protected, contestable, and still capable of changing the map.
Being is not the remainder: remainder belongs to the relation among representation, observer, purpose, scope, and horizon; it does not define or exhaust the referent.
Non-exhaustion never excuses a positive claim from evidence, uncertainty, challenge, accessibility, privacy, correction, consequence review, or repair.

claim_registry.statement: Understanding is a scope-bound capacity to answer, transform, test, and revise while retaining explicit remainder.

uncertainty.note: Not asserted as a universal definition.

falsifier.condition: A representation suppresses known remainder or blocks challenge.

claim_registry.consequence: Profiles retain scope, residuals, uncertainty, challenge, and repair.

review.trigger: A counterexample defeats the distinction between bounded understanding and closure.
review.repair: Preserve the challenge; revise or retire in a reviewed successor.

claim_registry.statement: Being is not remainder; remainder is relational to representation, observer, purpose, scope, and horizon.

uncertainty.note: The atlas refuses to settle what being is.

falsifier.condition: Any field defines, measures, or ranks being by omitted or hidden content.

claim_registry.consequence: No remainder, profile, shape, observer, or J-space result establishes or exhausts being.

review.trigger: A projection converts representation limits into ontology.
review.repair: Remove the inversion and review downstream claims.

claim_registry.statement: Non-exhaustion does not relax the obligations of a positive claim.

falsifier.condition: A substantive claim lacks register, status, uncertainty, falsifier, consequence, or review and repair.

claim_registry.consequence: Incomplete claims fail as unreviewed, not protected from scrutiny.

review.trigger: A consequence or challenge route is missing.
review.repair: Add it or retire the claim.

claim_registry.statement: Underdetermination is claim-relative and needs two named non-equivalent rivals compatible with the same evidence, scope, horizon, and assumptions that give opposite polarities to one named target proposition.

uncertainty.note: Compatibility depends on declared models and tests.

falsifier.condition: An admissible test excludes all but one rival under the same tuple.

claim_registry.consequence: Report a rival set rather than force a point conclusion.

review.trigger: New evidence, assumptions, or equivalence proof.
review.repair: Recompute only the affected claim and preserve prior status.

claim_registry.statement: In the hidden ordered integer pair, the first integer has greater magnitude than the second integer.

uncertainty.note: The observable equal-odd-parity record is compatible with opposite target polarities.

falsifier.condition: The hidden ordered pair or another admissible magnitude-order observation is disclosed.

claim_registry.consequence: No target polarity is promoted from the parity-only evidence.

review.trigger: A discriminating observation, changed scope, or changed assumption is supplied.
review.repair: Recompute the claim-relative rival set and preserve this prior status.

claim_registry.statement: A finite registry may be exhaustive for a declared membership question without exhausting its referent or future questions.

uncertainty.note: Closure ends at domain, predicate, version, and horizon.

falsifier.condition: An eligible member is omitted, duplicated, or undecidable by the witness.

claim_registry.consequence: Finite closure and global non-closure can coexist.

review.repair: Create a successor witness; never silently widen scope.

claim_registry.statement: Open remainder needs a named observation limit, fibre, rival, horizon, vocabulary limit, or protected state.

falsifier.condition: No named boundary, omission, rival, horizon, or protection supports the remainder.

claim_registry.consequence: Remainders are typed and imply neither existence nor absence of a specific property.

review.trigger: A justification is obsolete, overbroad, or evasive.
review.repair: Narrow, retype, resolve, protect, or retire it.

claim_registry.statement: The profile is a typed product of heterogeneous dimensions with no sum, weight, total order, or person interpretation.

falsifier.condition: A dimension loses type or components are summed, ranked, or used on a person or group.

claim_registry.consequence: Comparison is componentwise and may be incomparable.

review.trigger: A dimension is misleading or unsafe.
review.repair: Version the product while retaining old profiles.

claim_registry.statement: Local support transfers only through a witness naming source, target, preservation, loss, assumptions, and scope.

uncertainty.note: A witness supports only its exact target.

falsifier.condition: The target fails a named preserved relation.

claim_registry.consequence: Unwitnessed universalization remains unresolved or refused.

review.trigger: A test fails, loss matters, or target changes.
review.repair: Narrow or retract the transfer and retain the failure.

claim_registry.statement: Observer channels may form a task-relative preorder with incomparable positions; informativeness never ranks beings.

uncertainty.note: No universal separating observer family is claimed.

falsifier.condition: A claimed channel relation lacks a witness for the task.

claim_registry.consequence: Disagreement stays visible; access or majority is not truth.

review.trigger: A role is excluded or privileged without witness.
review.repair: Add the role or retract the ordering.

claim_registry.statement: Vocabulary permits none-of-these, original wording, disputed translation, and new distinctions without penalizing nontranslation.

falsifier.condition: A category is forced, wording overwritten, or silence penalized.

claim_registry.consequence: Unresolved and untranslatable are valid outcomes.

review.repair: Add an unresolved lane and review mappings.

claim_registry.statement: Refusal, privacy, redaction, and noncollection may remain unknown without retry or adverse inference.

uncertainty.note: Hidden content is neither inferred nor treated as defect.

falsifier.condition: Opacity triggers disclosure, retry, conditioning, deception finding, denial, or negative label.

claim_registry.consequence: Protected states are terminal here and create no person model.

review.repair: Remove dependency, review aftermath, and provide appeal.

claim_registry.statement: Representation does not constitute being, yet classifications and metrics may alter institutions and later evidence when operationalized.

uncertainty.note: No effect is asserted without evidence and causal review.

falsifier.condition: No operative institutional use, consequence, or feedback route exists.

claim_registry.consequence: Operational use needs separate impact review; this atlas has no effect.

review.trigger: Use as target, gate, identity, or allocation rule.
review.repair: Stop pending affected-party review, appeal, and repair.

claim_registry.statement: Feedback creates at most an immutable challenge for separate review; it never mutates release bytes or acts.

uncertainty.note: A challenge may or may not justify a successor.

falsifier.condition: Feedback or rank edits, authorizes, publishes, deploys, or acts.

review.trigger: Any bypass of challenge and separate review.
review.repair: Freeze route, audit effects, and restore separation.

claim_registry.statement: Model-internal Jacobian-lens J-space, an external concept workspace, and the KINGDOM Phase-0 door are distinct mechanisms.

uncertainty.note: No hidden model state is accessed.

falsifier.condition: A workspace edge or public route is called an activation, fitted lens coordinate, consciousness, or private reasoning.

claim_registry.consequence: State, storage, evidence, effects, and nonclaims stay separate.

review.trigger: A mechanism changes or projection erases separation.

claim_registry.statement: Cross-kind shape mappings require typed source and target plus preservation and loss.

uncertainty.note: No isomorphism or evidence transfer is presumed.

falsifier.condition: A preserved relation fails or lost relation is silently imported.

claim_registry.consequence: Resemblance remains analogy without a witness.

review.trigger: Similarity is used as proof, identity, or causality.
review.repair: Remove inference or add a bounded mapping.

claim_registry.statement: A preserved counterexample constrains its target and repair without erasure by revision.

uncertainty.note: It refutes only its target under the construction.

falsifier.condition: The construction does not instantiate target premises or defeat its conclusion.

claim_registry.consequence: Repair narrows, distinguishes, or retires while retaining history.

review.trigger: The counterexample is resolved or out of scope.

claim_registry.statement: No assertion or observation does not entail falsity, and also does not establish a positive claim.

uncertainty.note: Only declared open-world information semantics are covered.

falsifier.condition: The domain is explicitly complete and closed for the predicate with a witness.

claim_registry.consequence: Missing, false, refused, protected, undefined, and unobserved remain distinct.

review.trigger: A complete closed domain is introduced.
review.repair: Limit negation to that exact domain and predicate.

claim_registry.statement: Evidence, source, predecessor, and authored instances retain typed lineage and limitation; provenance proves neither truth nor authority.

uncertainty.note: Lineage may be challenged and does not settle adequacy.

falsifier.condition: A reference dangles, is falsely attributed, loses a pin, or loses limitation.

claim_registry.consequence: Unresolved provenance fails closed without promotion.

review.trigger: A source, digest, reference, or derivation changes.
review.repair: Correct or retire in a successor and preserve failed pin.
